SELECT rc.loan_id, rc.as_of_date
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
ORDER BY rc.loan_id;

SELECT loan_id, disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown
WHERE status = 'CHARGED_OFF'
ORDER BY loan_id;

SELECT payment_id, business_date, amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE is_cash = 1
  AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY amount DESC, payment_id;

SELECT pp.party_id, pp.annual_income
FROM person_profile pp
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON' AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY pp.annual_income DESC, pp.party_id;

SELECT card_id, issued_on, expires_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = '贷记卡'
ORDER BY issued_on, card_id;

SELECT op.party_id, p.display_name, op.operating_status
FROM organization_profile op
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = p.home_org_unit_id
WHERE op.registered_region = (
    SELECT ou2.region_code
    FROM organization_unit ou2
    WHERE ou2.unit_name = '上海分行'
)
ORDER BY op.party_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN account a ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY account_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT isc.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
       ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isc ON isc.sector_code = op.industry_code
GROUP BY isc.sector_code, isc.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, industry_name;

SELECT wp.product_name, ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_holding_amount
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY total_holding_amount DESC, wp.product_name
LIMIT 10;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name, COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = p.home_org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY relation_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       cs.net_capital,
       cs.risk_weighted_assets
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, ROUND(SUM(ab.ledger_balance), 2) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot ab ON ab.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ab.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM account_balance_snapshot)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_deposit_balance DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT oi.institution_name, AVG(ld.principal_overdue_days) AS avg_overdue_days
FROM delinquency_snapshot ld
JOIN loan_drawdown l ON l.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = l.agreement_id
JOIN institution oi ON oi.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ld.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY oi.institution_id, oi.institution_name
HAVING AVG(ld.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY avg_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT eg.exposure_group_id,
       eg.group_name,
       ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)), 2) AS exposure_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(cs.net_capital), 0), 6) AS exposure_ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
LEFT JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY exposure_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    is2.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS loan_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN ca.agreement_id END) AS nonperforming_count,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN ca.agreement_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id), 6) AS nonperforming_ratio
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector is2 ON is2.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY is2.sector_code, is2.sector_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) >= 20
ORDER BY nonperforming_ratio DESC, is2.sector_name_zh;

SELECT p.party_id AS customer_id, p.display_name AS customer_name, ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, p.party_id
LIMIT 15;

SELECT risk_level, COUNT(*) AS product_count, ROUND(AVG(management_fee_rate), 4) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM wealth_product
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY risk_level;

SELECT g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name, ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = g.guarantor_party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed DESC, g.guarantor_party_id;

SELECT p.party_id AS customer_id, p.display_name AS customer_name, ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS record_count, ROUND(SUM(dse.observed_value), 2) AS total_observed_value
FROM data_security_event_v3 dse
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = dse.institution_id
WHERE dse.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_observed_value DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
WHERE r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL AND cs.risk_weighted_assets <> 0
ORDER BY capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS classification_name,
    rc.as_of_date AS classification_date
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND cg.grade_name_zh IN ('正常', '关注')
  AND rc.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date)
      FROM risk_classification rc2
      WHERE rc2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
  )
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT ou.unit_name AS institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = ca.managing_org_unit_id
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = lbs.as_of_date
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
  AND ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY ou.unit_name
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY insufficient_provision_loan_balance DESC, ou.unit_name;

SELECT pi.instruction_id, pi.loan_id, p.display_name AS payee_name, 
       isec.sector_name_zh AS industry_name_zh, pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON isec.sector_code = op.industry_code
WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
  AND pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS restricted_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 6) AS restricted_ratio
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector ind ON ind.sector_code = op.industry_code
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY restricted_ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT wp.product_id, wp.product_name, ma.asset_id, ma.maturity_on, wp.actual_termination_on
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.actual_termination_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS borrower_count
FROM party p
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gc.commitment_id IS NOT NULL AND ca.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY guarantee_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT pe.payment_id, pe.business_date, ptc.name_zh AS payment_type_name, pe.amount, ou.unit_name
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON ptc.payment_type = pe.payment_type
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = pe.origin_org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, p.display_name AS borrower_name,
       org_profile.industry_code AS borrower_industry_code,
       ca.target_industry_code AS agreement_industry_code,
       ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile org_profile ON org_profile.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND org_profile.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code <> org_profile.industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT pe.payment_id, pe.business_date, pe.amount,
       ah_from.party_id AS payer_party_id,
       ah_to.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON ah_from.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON ah_to.account_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id
                      AND pr.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
  AND pe.status = '清算完成'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, p.display_name AS borrower_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
       SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event p
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = p.from_account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE p.is_cash = 1
  AND p.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT sm.staff_id, COUNT(*) AS trade_count
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON pe.to_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON isec.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN staff_assignment sa ON sa.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = sa.staff_id
WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')
GROUP BY sm.staff_id
ORDER BY trade_count DESC, sm.staff_id
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    record_id AS 台账记录编号,
    institution_name AS 机构名称,
    event_date AS 事项发生日期,
    deadline_date AS 法定截止日期,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS 距截止日天数差
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 cdde
JOIN institution i ON cdde.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE completion_date IS NULL
  AND deadline_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 距截止日天数差 DESC, record_id
LIMIT 20;

SELECT sa.security_id, cl.collateral_id, ca.status AS collateral_status, sa.status AS security_status
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE cl.status = 'RELEASED' AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.security_id;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ca.agreement_id, sg.security_id, sg.secured_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sg ON sg.security_id = so.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sg.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sg.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    lb.loan_id,
    lb.principal_balance,
    rn AS balance_rank
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.agreement_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ca.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lb.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE lb.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb2 
        WHERE lb2.loan_id = lb.loan_id
    )
) ranked
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ranked.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ranked.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ind.sector_name_zh AS 行业中文名称,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    lbs.principal_balance AS 本金余额,
    rn AS 排名
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.agreement_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY op.industry_code ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
) AS ranked
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ranked.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE ranked.rn <= 3
ORDER BY ind.sector_name_zh ASC, ranked.rn ASC;

SELECT business_date, COUNT(*) AS daily_count,
       COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS change_from_previous
FROM payment_event
GROUP BY business_date
ORDER BY business_date;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ld.loan_id,
       lbs.principal_balance,
       ROUND(inst_avg.avg_principal, 2) AS institution_avg_balance,
       ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - inst_avg.avg_principal, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca2.institution_id, AVG(lbs2.principal_balance) AS avg_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld2
    JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON ld2.agreement_id = ca2.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 ON ld2.loan_id = lbs2.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca2.institution_id
) inst_avg ON ca.institution_id = inst_avg.institution_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > inst_avg.avg_principal
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

SELECT sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount, COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM security_agreement sa
LEFT JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE sa.security_type = '第三方保证'
  AND cl.collateral_link_id IS NULL
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN '未逾期'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '31-90天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360天'
        ELSE '360天以上'
    END AS overdue_interval,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot
GROUP BY overdue_interval
ORDER BY MIN(principal_overdue_days);

SELECT collateral_id, valued_on, COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM collateral_valuation
GROUP BY collateral_id, valued_on
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY collateral_id ASC, valued_on ASC;

SELECT p.party_id,
       p.display_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id), 2) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM party p
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
  AND op.organization_kind = 'CORPORATE'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) > 0
ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC, p.party_id
LIMIT 5;

SELECT ou.unit_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count,
       COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.operator_id IN (
    SELECT so.operator_id
    FROM service_operator so
    WHERE so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
)
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, ou.unit_name
LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.customer_segment,
       COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
       ROUND(AVG(pp.annual_income), 2) AS avg_annual_income,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS high_income_ratio
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY p.customer_segment ASC;

WITH payment_with_org AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.payment_id,
        pe.amount,
        COALESCE(a_from.institution_id, a_to.institution_id) AS institution_id,
        ah_from.party_id AS from_party_id,
        ah_to.party_id AS to_party_id
    FROM payment_event pe
    LEFT JOIN account a_from ON a_from.account_id = pe.from_account_id
    LEFT JOIN account a_to ON a_to.account_id = pe.to_account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_holder ah_from ON ah_from.account_id = pe.from_account_id 
        AND ah_from.effective_to IS NULL
    LEFT JOIN account_holder ah_to ON ah_to.account_id = pe.to_account_id 
        AND ah_to.effective_to IS NULL
    WHERE pe.status = 'COMPLETED'
),
related_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        pwo.payment_id,
        pwo.amount,
        pwo.institution_id
    FROM payment_with_org pwo
    JOIN party_relation pr 
        ON pr.source_party_id = pwo.from_party_id 
        AND pr.target_party_id = pwo.to_party_id
        AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
        AND pr.effective_from <= date('now')
        AND (pr.effective_to IS NULL OR pr.effective_to >= date('now'))
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM payment_with_org
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
related_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        SUM(amount) AS related_amount
    FROM related_payments
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(COALESCE(rt.related_amount, 0), 2) AS related_amount,
    ROUND(t.total_amount, 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(rt.related_amount, 0) * 100.0 / t.total_amount, 2) AS related_ratio
FROM totals t
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = t.institution_id
LEFT JOIN related_totals rt ON rt.institution_id = t.institution_id
ORDER BY related_ratio DESC;

SELECT p.party_id AS customer_id,
       p.display_name AS customer_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS credit_card_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS term_deposit_count
FROM party p
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
LEFT JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT' AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND (pc.card_id IS NOT NULL OR td.account_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) > 0
ORDER BY term_deposit_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS avg_loan_age_days
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY avg_loan_age_days DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT loan_id, principal_balance, quartile_group
FROM (
    SELECT loan_id, principal_balance,
           NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
)
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH borrower_industry AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        op.industry_code
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
),
industry_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.industry_code,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS balance
    FROM borrower_industry bi
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = bi.borrower_party_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
    GROUP BY bi.industry_code
),
total_balance AS (
    SELECT SUM(balance) AS total FROM industry_balance
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        ib.industry_code,
        ib.balance,
        SUM(ib.balance) OVER (ORDER BY ib.balance DESC) AS running_total,
        ib.balance * 1.0 / (SELECT total FROM total_balance) AS pct
    FROM industry_balance ib
)
SELECT 
    isec.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    ROUND(r.balance, 2) AS balance_total,
    ROUND(SUM(r.pct) OVER (ORDER BY r.balance DESC), 6) AS cumulative_ratio
FROM ranked r
JOIN industry_sector isec ON isec.sector_code = r.industry_code
WHERE SUM(r.pct) OVER (ORDER BY r.balance DESC) <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT p.party_id AS customer_id,
       p.display_name AS customer_name,
       i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS outstanding_loan_count
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND (ld.closed_on IS NULL OR ld.closed_on = '')
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY outstanding_loan_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount, ca.collateral_id, cv.latest_valuation
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
JOIN (
    SELECT collateral_id, valuation_amount AS latest_valuation
    FROM collateral_valuation cv
    WHERE cv.valuation_id = (
        SELECT cv2.valuation_id
        FROM collateral_valuation cv2
        WHERE cv2.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
        ORDER BY cv2.valued_on DESC, cv2.valuation_id DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
) cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.latest_valuation > sa.secured_amount * 2
ORDER BY (cv.latest_valuation - sa.secured_amount) DESC, sa.security_id, ca.collateral_id;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS institution_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
WHERE a.institution_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 1
ORDER BY institution_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT from_account_id, business_date, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event
GROUP BY from_account_id, business_date
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, from_account_id, business_date
LIMIT 20;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS member_count,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_balance
FROM institution i
JOIN account a ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_balance DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name, COUNT(*) AS guarantee_count, ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id;

SELECT ou.unit_name AS 机构名称, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = ca.managing_org_unit_id
WHERE ca.payment_mode = '受托支付'
  AND ld.status = '有效'
GROUP BY ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 借据笔数 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS 借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = l.loan_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = l.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.institution_id FROM credit_agreement ca WHERE ca.agreement_id = l.agreement_id
)
WHERE l.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(lbs.overdue_since) >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY 借据笔数 DESC;

SELECT ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
       p.display_name AS 借款方名称,
       pi.instruction_amount AS 指令金额,
       payee.display_name AS 收款方名称
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN payment_instruction pi ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN party payee ON payee.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
WHERE pi.payment_mode = '受托支付'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE p.status = 'FROZEN'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT ld.loan_id, lpc.product_name_zh, isec.sector_name_zh, ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON lpc.product_code = ca.product_family
JOIN industry_sector isec ON isec.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE lpc.is_working_capital = 1
  AND isec.risk_category = '退出类'
  AND ld.status = '正常'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ld.loan_id,
       lbs.principal_balance,
       ROUND(avg_balance.avg_principal_balance, 2) AS avg_principal_balance,
       ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - avg_balance.avg_principal_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.institution_id,
           AVG(lbs2.principal_balance) AS avg_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld2
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 ON lbs2.loan_id = ld2.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) avg_balance ON avg_balance.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > 2 * avg_balance.avg_principal_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM party_relation pr
           WHERE pr.source_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
             AND pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
       ) THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS non_related_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM party_relation pr
           WHERE pr.source_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
             AND pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
       ) THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ca.contract_amount), 4) AS non_related_ratio
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY non_related_ratio DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       p.display_name AS customer_name,
       ROUND(SUM(lb.principal_balance), 2) AS total_balance,
       ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
       ROUND(SUM(lb.principal_balance) * 100.0 / cs.net_capital, 2) AS concentration_ratio
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lb.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id
)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, p.party_id, p.display_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(lb.principal_balance) * 100.0 / cs.net_capital > 10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS execution_rate,
    ROUND(avg_rate.avg_rate, 2) AS industry_avg_rate,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - avg_rate.avg_rate) * 100.0 / avg_rate.avg_rate, 2) AS premium_pct
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT target_industry_code, AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement
    WHERE target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
      AND status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY target_industry_code
) avg_rate ON avg_rate.target_industry_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate > avg_rate.avg_rate * 1.10
ORDER BY premium_pct DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.borrower_party_id) AS customer_count
FROM credit_agreement c
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = c.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = c.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > 0.1 * cs.net_capital
  AND c.borrower_party_id IN (
      SELECT party_id FROM party WHERE party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
  )
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH group_capital AS (
    SELECT eg.exposure_group_id,
           eg.institution_id,
           cs.net_capital
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
    WHERE cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id)
),
group_exposure AS (
    SELECT egm.exposure_group_id,
           SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS balance_total
    FROM exposure_group_member egm
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ca.institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM exposure_group WHERE exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id)
    GROUP BY egm.exposure_group_id
)
SELECT eg.exposure_group_id,
       eg.group_name,
       ROUND(ge.balance_total, 2) AS balance_total,
       ROUND(gc.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
       ROUND(ge.balance_total * 100.0 / gc.net_capital, 2) AS exposure_ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN group_capital gc ON gc.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN group_exposure ge ON ge.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
WHERE ge.balance_total * 100.0 / gc.net_capital > 10
ORDER BY exposure_ratio DESC;

SELECT ca.agreement_id,
       ca.maturity_on,
       ld.loan_id,
       ld.status,
       ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'EXPIRED'
  AND ld.status = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT ld.loan_id,
       ld.loan_account_id,
       ld.disbursed_on,
       pe.payment_id,
       pe.business_date,
       pe.amount,
       CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_between
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = ld.loan_account_id
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.business_date >= ld.disbursed_on
  AND CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) <= 7
ORDER BY days_between ASC, pe.amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name, p.display_name AS customer_name, 
       (lb.principal_balance * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) AS ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE lb.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
  AND cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot)
  AND lb.principal_balance > 0
  AND cs.net_capital > 0
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, p.party_id, p.display_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING lb.principal_balance = (
    SELECT MAX(lb2.principal_balance)
    FROM credit_agreement ca2
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON ld2.agreement_id = ca2.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb2 ON lb2.loan_id = ld2.loan_id
    WHERE ca2.institution_id = i.institution_id
      AND lb2.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
)
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT loan_id, principal_balance, quartile
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS quartile
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
    JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ou.institution_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
) ranked
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS 本金余额,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 100.0 / inst_tot.total_principal, 2) AS 占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) inst_tot ON inst_tot.institution_id = ca.institution_id
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC, 占比 DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT ld.loan_id,
       ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
       ld.status,
       ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS overdue_principal,
       COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'NORMAL'
  AND rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC, overdue_principal DESC, ld.loan_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT ld.loan_account_id, ld.disbursed_on, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM loan_drawdown ld
GROUP BY ld.loan_account_id, ld.disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY cnt DESC, ld.loan_account_id, ld.disbursed_on
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT ah.party_id
FROM account_holder ah
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = ah.party_id
ORDER BY ah.party_id;

SELECT sm.person_party_id
FROM staff_member sm
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account_holder ah
    WHERE ah.party_id = sm.person_party_id
  )
ORDER BY sm.person_party_id ASC;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM payment_event pe
    WHERE pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
      AND pe.is_cash = 1
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT g.security_id, g.guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment g
WHERE g.status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY g.guaranteed_amount DESC, g.security_id;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(rs.due_date) < 0 THEN '已到期'
    WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(rs.due_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN '临期'
    ELSE '常态'
  END AS bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM repayment_schedule rs
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN '常态' THEN 1 WHEN '临期' THEN 2 WHEN '已到期' THEN 3 END;

SELECT cl.collateral_id, COUNT(*) AS link_count
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY link_count DESC, cl.collateral_id;

SELECT ca.collateral_type,
       ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS avg_valuation,
       COUNT(*) AS valuation_count
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY avg_valuation DESC;

SELECT 
    p.from_account_id AS repayment_account_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    cnt.cnt AS account_loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event p ON p.to_account_id = ld.repayment_account_id
JOIN (
    SELECT repayment_account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM loan_drawdown
    WHERE repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY repayment_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
) cnt ON cnt.repayment_account_id = ld.repayment_account_id
WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
  AND ld.loan_id IN (
      SELECT loan_id
      FROM (
          SELECT loan_id, repayment_account_id, disbursed_on,
                 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY repayment_account_id ORDER BY disbursed_on, loan_id) AS rn
          FROM loan_drawdown
          WHERE repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
      )
      WHERE rn <= 2
  )
ORDER BY ld.repayment_account_id, ld.disbursed_on, ld.loan_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ca.agreement_id,
       ca.contract_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_disbursed,
       ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount, 2) AS excess_amount,
       COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS drawdown_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS 账户数量,
       ROUND(SUM(ABS(ABS(bs.ledger_balance) - ABS(bs.available_balance))), 2) AS 差额合计
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot bs ON bs.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE bs.ledger_balance > bs.available_balance
  AND (bs.ledger_balance - bs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 差额合计 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT td.account_id, td.opening_principal, td.maturity_on, td.annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on;

SELECT card_id, card_type, issued_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY issued_on, card_id;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'TRUSTEE' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 累计受托支付金额,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode != 'TRUSTEE' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 累计自主支付金额,
       ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'TRUSTEE' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 0), 4) AS 受托支付占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 受托支付占比 < 0.52
ORDER BY 受托支付占比 ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 单笔放款金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) AS 合同内累计放款金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id), 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) > 90
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT wi.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 实际募集合计,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 计划募集合计,
       ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS 完成率
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution wi ON wi.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
GROUP BY wi.institution_id, wi.institution_name
HAVING 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) > 1.2
ORDER BY 完成率 DESC, wi.institution_name;

SELECT p.party_id AS borrower_id,
       p.display_name AS borrower_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = '逾期' THEN ld.loan_id END) AS overdue_loan_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS total_loan_count
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE rs.status = '逾期'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM loan_drawdown ld2
      JOIN repayment_schedule rs2 ON rs2.loan_id = ld2.loan_id
      WHERE ld2.agreement_id IN (SELECT ca2.agreement_id FROM credit_agreement ca2 WHERE ca2.borrower_party_id = p.party_id)
        AND rs2.status != '逾期'
  )
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = '逾期' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status != '逾期' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT pi.instruction_id,
       pi.loan_id,
       borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
       payee.display_name AS payee_name,
       ROUND(pi.instruction_amount, 2) AS instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON borrower.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN party payee ON payee.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id <> ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_on, ca.agreement_id, ca.signed_on, ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT rs.loan_id AS 借据编号,
       COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 未结清期次数,
       ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 应还本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.loan_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT rs2.loan_id
    FROM repayment_schedule rs2
    WHERE rs2.status = 'PAID'
)
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
ORDER BY 应还本金合计 DESC, rs.loan_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT l.loan_id,
       ROUND(lb.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
       ROUND(lb.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb ON lb.loan_id = l.loan_id
WHERE l.status = 'CHARGED_OFF'
  AND lb.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC, l.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_on, ld.disbursement_account_id, a.opened_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.disbursement_account_id, a.account_kind, ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, ca.security_type, ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount, p.display_name
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = 'UNSECURED' AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
       ca.borrower_party_id AS 客户编号,
       ca.annual_interest_rate AS 合同年利率,
       ROUND(avg_rate.avg_rate, 4) AS 同机构同类产品平均年利率,
       ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate - avg_rate.avg_rate, 4) AS 利率价差
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca2.institution_id, ca2.product_family, AVG(ca2.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca2
    GROUP BY ca2.institution_id, ca2.product_family
) avg_rate ON avg_rate.institution_id = ca.institution_id AND avg_rate.product_family = ca.product_family
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate < avg_rate.avg_rate
  AND ca.borrower_party_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT pr.source_party_id
      FROM party_relation pr
      WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
        AND pr.source_party_id IN (SELECT borrower_party_id FROM credit_agreement)
      UNION
      SELECT DISTINCT pr.target_party_id
      FROM party_relation pr
      WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
        AND pr.target_party_id IN (SELECT borrower_party_id FROM credit_agreement)
  )
ORDER BY 利率价差 DESC, ca.borrower_party_id;

SELECT pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id, rc.relation_name_zh
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rc ON rc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
  AND pr.source_party_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT borrower_party_id FROM credit_agreement)
  AND pr.target_party_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT borrower_party_id FROM credit_agreement)
ORDER BY rc.relation_name_zh, pr.relation_id;

SELECT 
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 成员数,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 余额合计,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS 资本净额,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS 占比
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date) 
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
    WHERE lbs2.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
)
AND cs.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(cs2.as_of_date) 
    FROM capital_snapshot cs2 
    WHERE cs2.institution_id = cs.institution_id
)
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 2
AND SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.1
ORDER BY 占比 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    payer.display_name AS 付款方姓名,
    payee.display_name AS 收款方姓名,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pe.payment_id) AS 转账笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 转账金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON ah_from.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN party payer ON payer.party_id = ah_from.party_id
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON ah_to.account_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN party payee ON payee.party_id = ah_to.party_id
WHERE pe.payment_type = '转账'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM party_relation pr
      WHERE pr.source_party_id = payer.party_id
        AND pr.target_party_id = payee.party_id
        AND pr.relation_type <> '非关联方'
        AND (pr.effective_to IS NULL OR pr.effective_to >= pe.business_date)
  )
GROUP BY payer.party_id, payer.display_name, payee.party_id, payee.display_name
ORDER BY 转账金额合计 DESC, 付款方姓名, 收款方姓名;

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, a.asset_name
FROM wealth_product p
JOIN product_holding_snapshot ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN managed_asset a ON a.asset_id = ph.asset_id
WHERE p.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ph.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY p.product_id;

SELECT phs.product_id, COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
WHERE phs.investment_path = 'MULTI_LAYER_INTERMEDIARY'
GROUP BY phs.product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, phs.product_id
LIMIT 20;

SELECT ld.loan_id,
       lbs.principal_balance,
       MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS max_overdue_days
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > 90000000
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance
HAVING MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY max_overdue_days DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
       eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS 涉及机构数,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 取得授信的成员数
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE egm.effective_to IS NULL
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 涉及机构数 DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

SELECT eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 逾期成员数, ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

SELECT op.party_id,
       p.display_name,
       ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guarantee,
       ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_loan,
       ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) - SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS gap
FROM organization_profile op
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.guarantor_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
GROUP BY op.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > SUM(ca.contract_amount)
ORDER BY gap DESC, op.party_id;

SELECT p.display_name AS 员工姓名, sm.staff_id AS 员工编号, COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS 授信合同笔数
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sm.staff_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 授信合同笔数 DESC, sm.staff_id

SELECT p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
       p.party_id AS 客户编号,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
       pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
  AND lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 2
ORDER BY 倍数 DESC, p.party_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
       so.operator_id AS 操作员编号,
       so.authority_level AS 权限级别,
       COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS 自贷合同数
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = '信贷经办员'
  AND so.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.display_name, so.operator_id, so.authority_level
ORDER BY 自贷合同数 DESC, p.display_name;

SELECT sp.display_name AS staff_name, ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.disbursed_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.person_party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN party sp ON sp.party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 借款人客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 个人年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due), 2) AS 应还本息总额,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 占年收入倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
ORDER BY 占年收入倍数 DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT lpc.product_name_zh AS 产品类别名称,
       COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 逾期期数,
       ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON lpc.product_family = ca.product_family
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY lpc.product_family, lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, lpc.product_name_zh;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_90_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > julianday('2026-06-30') + 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_90_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY expired_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ah.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN account a ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) > 1
ORDER BY joint_account_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lds.loan_id) AS overdue_count, ROUND(SUM(lds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lds
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lds.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = ca.managing_org_unit_id
WHERE lds.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT 
    rs.loan_id,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installments,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS overdue_principal_total
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND rs.principal_due > 0
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING SUM(rs.principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY overdue_principal_total DESC, rs.loan_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_count,
       SUM(rs.interest_due) AS total_interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = '逾期'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(rs.installment_id) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) AS 逾期贷款数
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = '逾期'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY 逾期贷款数 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT loan_id, installment_no, principal_due, interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule
WHERE status = 'OVERDUE' AND principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY principal_due DESC, loan_id, installment_no;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 授信额度合计,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS 发放金额合计,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS 资本净额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS 发放对资本净额占比
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 发放对资本净额占比 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
       sa.secured_amount AS 设定担保金额,
       COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人个数,
       ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 保证金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
  AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 保证金额合计 DESC, sa.security_id;

SELECT cf.facility_id, cf.limit_amount, sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN status_catalog sc ON sc.entity = 'credit_facility' AND sc.status_code = cf.status
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
ORDER BY cf.limit_amount DESC, cf.facility_id;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       cf.facility_type AS 授信类型代码,
       ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 授信限额合计
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cf.facility_type
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY 授信限额合计 DESC;

SELECT facility_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM credit_facility
WHERE limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY facility_type
ORDER BY record_count DESC, facility_type;

SELECT pmc.payment_mode_name_zh, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS record_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pmc.payment_mode = ld.payment_mode
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY record_count DESC, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh;

SELECT quartile_group,
       COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM (
    SELECT product_id,
           NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE'
) t
WHERE product_id IN (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
)
GROUP BY quartile_group
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 循环授信限额合计, COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 发放笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.facility_id = ca.facility_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = '循环授信'
  AND ld.payment_mode = '受托支付'
GROUP BY cf.facility_id
ORDER BY 循环授信限额合计 DESC;

SELECT pm.payment_mode_name_zh AS 支付方式, COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS 待执行指令数量
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pm ON pm.payment_mode = pi.payment_mode
WHERE pi.status = '待执行'
GROUP BY pm.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 待执行指令数量 DESC, pm.payment_mode_name_zh;

SELECT itc.name_zh AS instrument_type_name, sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM instrument_type_catalog itc
CROSS JOIN status_catalog sc
WHERE sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY itc.name_zh, sc.name_zh;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS credit_manager_count
FROM organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN staff_assignment sa ON sa.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id AND sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
LEFT JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = sa.staff_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY credit_manager_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT ld.loan_id, cc.grade_name_zh AS 五级分类名称, dl.principal_overdue_days AS 本金逾期天数, dl.overdue_principal AS 逾期本金
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cc ON cc.grade_code = rc.grade_code
JOIN delinquency_snapshot dl ON dl.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE dl.principal_overdue_days > 30
  AND cc.is_nonperforming = 0
ORDER BY dl.principal_overdue_days DESC, ld.loan_id ASC

select i.institution_name,
  count(*) as 覆盖不足笔数
from loan_drawdown d
join credit_agreement ca on ca.agreement_id = d.agreement_id
join institution i on i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
join provision_snapshot ps on ps.loan_id = d.loan_id
where ps.provision_stage = 'STAGE_2'
  and ps.recognized_amount < 0.5 * ps.required_amount
group by i.institution_id, i.institution_name
order by 覆盖不足笔数 desc, i.institution_name asc

select i.institution_name, round(sum(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) as 拨备缺口合计
from provision_snapshot p
join loan_drawdown l on l.loan_id = p.loan_id
join credit_agreement ca on ca.agreement_id = l.agreement_id
join institution i on i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
where p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
group by i.institution_name
order by 拨备缺口合计 desc, i.institution_name

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_subtype, b.ledger_balance
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot b ON b.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
WHERE a.status = 'DORMANT'
  AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND ah.account_holder_id IS NULL
ORDER BY b.ledger_balance DESC, a.account_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT p.customer_segment,
       COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment;

SELECT ma.asset_category_primary,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM managed_asset ma
WHERE ma.is_monitored_sector = 1
GROUP BY ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY cnt DESC, ma.asset_category_primary;

SELECT p.party_id AS 客户编号,
       pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
       ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 授信额度合计,
       ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 偿债比
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(ca.contract_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY 偿债比 DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT pp.occupation_code, pp.employment_sector, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile pp
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
GROUP BY pp.occupation_code, pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, pp.occupation_code ASC, pp.employment_sector ASC

SELECT pc.status AS card_status, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card pc
WHERE pc.card_type = '借记卡'
GROUP BY pc.status
ORDER BY card_count DESC, pc.status ASC;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
       ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
       COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 交易笔数,
       ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pc.holder_party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = p.home_org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND a.account_kind = 'CREDIT_CARD'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 金额合计 DESC, ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT pe.payment_id, pc.card_id, pc.holder_party_id, pe.business_date, pe.amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT txn.card_holder_id AS 持卡人编号,
       COUNT(*) AS 现金交易笔数,
       ROUND(SUM(txn.transaction_amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM card_transaction txn
WHERE txn.transaction_type = 'CASH'
GROUP BY txn.card_holder_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, SUM(txn.transaction_amount) DESC;

SELECT holder_party_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, holder_party_id;

SELECT ctc.name_zh AS card_type_name,
       COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
       ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON ctc.card_type = pc.card_type
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pc.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')
GROUP BY ctc.card_type, ctc.name_zh
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, ctc.name_zh ASC;

SELECT p.channel,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt,
       ROUND(AVG(p.amount), 2) AS avg_amt
FROM payment_event p
WHERE p.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND p.is_cash = 0
GROUP BY p.channel
HAVING AVG(p.amount) > 11780000
ORDER BY avg_amt DESC, p.channel;

SELECT td.account_id, td.maturity_on, a.status
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on < date('now')
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on DESC, td.account_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT c.collateral_id, c.asset_label, MAX(cv.valuation_amount) AS max_valuation
FROM collateral_asset c
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = c.collateral_id
GROUP BY c.collateral_id, c.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY max_valuation DESC, c.collateral_id;

select c.collateral_id, c.asset_label, count(cl.collateral_link_id) as 押品被引用次数, count(distinct cl.security_id) as 关联不同担保合同数
from collateral_asset c
join collateral_link cl on cl.collateral_id = c.collateral_id
where cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
group by c.collateral_id, c.asset_label
having count(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
order by 押品被引用次数 desc, c.collateral_id

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT ld.agreement_id, SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
)
SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 保证承诺金额,
    ROUND(lt.total_disbursed, 2) AS 实际放款总金额
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN loan_totals lt ON lt.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.guaranteed_amount > lt.total_disbursed
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id ASC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

select ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount, 
       round(coalesce(sum(sa.secured_amount), 0), 2) as 担保覆盖合计,
       round(ca.contract_amount - coalesce(sum(sa.secured_amount), 0), 2) as 保障缺口
from credit_agreement ca
join secured_obligation so on so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
join security_agreement sa on sa.security_id = so.security_id
where ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  and sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
  and so.effective_to is null
group by ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
having 保障缺口 > 0
order by 保障缺口 desc, ca.agreement_id
limit 100

select i.institution_name,
       cg.grade_name_zh as 五级分类名称,
       count(*) as 拨备不足借据笔数
from loan_drawdown ld
join credit_agreement ca on ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
join institution i on i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
join risk_classification rc on rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
join classification_grade cg on cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
join provision_snapshot ps on ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
where cg.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
  and ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
group by i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
order by 拨备不足借据笔数 desc, i.institution_name asc

select ca.borrower_party_id as 债务人编号,
       ld.loan_id as 借据编号,
       round(lbs.principal_balance, 2) as 贷款余额,
       ca.contract_amount as 授信金额,
       round(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) as 余额倍数
from loan_drawdown ld
join credit_agreement ca on ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
join loan_balance_snapshot lbs on lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
where lbs.as_of_date = (
    select max(as_of_date) from loan_balance_snapshot where loan_id = ld.loan_id
)
  and lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount >= 4
order by 余额倍数 desc, ld.loan_id

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 五级分类名称,
    COUNT(*) AS 多计提笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount), 2) AS 多计提金额合计
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND rc.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date) 
        FROM risk_classification rc2 
        WHERE rc2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cg.grade_code, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 多计提金额合计 DESC, 机构名称 ASC, 五级分类名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 2) AS internal_max_value,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 2) AS external_max_value,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) - MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 2) AS undervaluation_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.valuation_type IN ('INTERNAL', 'EXTERNAL')
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) > MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END)
ORDER BY undervaluation_gap DESC, ca.collateral_id;

SELECT ca.collateral_id,
       ca.asset_label,
       cv.latest_valuation_amount,
       COALESCE(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 0) AS total_pledged,
       ROUND(cv.latest_valuation_amount - COALESCE(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 0), 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN (
    SELECT collateral_id, valuation_amount AS latest_valuation_amount
    FROM collateral_valuation cv
    WHERE cv.valuation_id = (
        SELECT cv2.valuation_id
        FROM collateral_valuation cv2
        WHERE cv2.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
        ORDER BY cv2.valued_on DESC, cv2.valuation_id DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
) cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cl.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, cv.latest_valuation_amount
HAVING cv.latest_valuation_amount < COALESCE(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 0)
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC, ca.collateral_id;

SELECT g.guarantor_party_id,
       p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ca.borrower_party_id = g.guarantor_party_id THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS self_loan_total,
       ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS external_guarantee_total
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = g.guarantor_party_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = g.security_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND g.effective_to IS NULL
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ca.borrower_party_id = g.guarantor_party_id
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > SUM(CASE WHEN ca.borrower_party_id = g.guarantor_party_id THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END)
ORDER BY external_guarantee_total DESC;

SELECT sa.security_id, 
       ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS secured_amount,
       COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
       ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) DESC, sa.security_id;

SELECT p.customer_segment,

SELECT i.institution_name,

       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 成员去重数量
FROM exposure_group eg

GROUP BY i.institution_name, egc.name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY 成员去重数量 DESC;

SELECT egm.party_id AS 成员客户编号, p.display_name AS 客户名称, COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
