SELECT p.party_id AS 主体编号, p.display_name AS 主体名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id OR p.party_id = pr.target_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联关系条数 DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT p.party_id,
       p.display_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type = 'SHADOW_SHAREHOLDER'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY group_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT pr.relation_id AS 关系编号,
       pr.source_party_id AS 关系一方主体编号,
       pr.target_party_id AS 关系另一方主体编号,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) AS 一主体现有借款合同数,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id) AS 另一主体现有借款合同数
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN credit_agreement ca1 ON ca1.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON ca2.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id)) DESC;

select c.collateral_id, c.asset_label, c.collateral_type
from collateral_asset c
where c.status = 'ACTIVE'
  and not exists (
    select 1 from collateral_link cl
    where cl.collateral_id = c.collateral_id and cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
order by c.collateral_id asc

WITH guarantor_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND (gc.effective_to IS NULL OR gc.effective_to >= date('now'))
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
borrower_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 WHERE lbs2.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    )
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(ge.total_guarantee, 2) AS 有效保证责任合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(be.total_loan, 0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额,
    ROUND(ge.total_guarantee - COALESCE(be.total_loan, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM guarantor_exposure ge
LEFT JOIN borrower_exposure be ON be.borrower_party_id = ge.guarantor_party_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ge.guarantor_party_id
WHERE ge.total_guarantee > COALESCE(be.total_loan, 0)
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
       p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
       g.guaranteed_amount AS 保证金额,
       g.status AS 保证状态
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = g.guarantor_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = g.guarantor_party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
  AND g.effective_to IS NULL
  AND g.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY g.guaranteed_amount DESC, g.guarantor_party_id ASC;

WITH RECURSIVE product_assets AS (
    -- 直接持有的资产
    SELECT 
        phs.product_id,
        phs.asset_id,
        phs.investment_path,
        phs.lookthrough_depth,
        phs.intermediary_party_id,
        ma.obligor_party_id AS final_obligor_party_id
    FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
    JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
    WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth = 0
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- 递归：通过中间产品间接持有的资产
    SELECT 
        pa.product_id,
        phs.asset_id,
        phs.investment_path,
        phs.lookthrough_depth,
        phs.intermediary_party_id,
        ma.obligor_party_id AS final_obligor_party_id
    FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
    JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
    JOIN product_assets pa ON pa.asset_id = phs.intermediary_party_id
    WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth > 0
)
SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    pa.final_obligor_party_id,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS overdue_principal_total
FROM product_assets pa
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = pa.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = pa.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id 
    FROM credit_agreement ca 
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pa.final_obligor_party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pa.final_obligor_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, pa.final_obligor_party_id
ORDER BY wp.product_name ASC, overdue_principal_total DESC;

SELECT sa.security_type,
       COUNT(so.secured_obligation_id) AS secured_count,
       ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS covered_total
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY SUM(so.covered_amount) DESC, sa.security_type;

SELECT ca.agreement_id,
       p.display_name AS borrower_name,
       ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
LEFT JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND (cl.collateral_id IS NOT NULL OR gc.guarantor_party_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) > 0
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
       ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM institution i
JOIN exposure_group eg ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE eg.group_type = '关联客户型'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY SUM(ca.contract_amount) DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT wp.product_id,
       wp.product_name,
       ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS 倒挂金额合计,
       COUNT(*) AS 构成倒挂的持仓笔数
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
WHERE phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY 倒挂金额合计 DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 0) AS overdue_principal_total
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ma.issuer_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id 
    FROM credit_agreement ca 
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
  AND wp.issuer_institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    phs.holding_id
ORDER BY 
    phs.lookthrough_depth DESC,
    phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cl.collateral_id AS 抵押物编号,
    COUNT(*) AS 第一顺位有效记录数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 超过百分之六十的记录数
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND cl.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 超过百分之六十的记录数 DESC, cl.collateral_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       fs.total_assets,
       fs.total_liabilities,
       fs.net_assets,
       fs.annual_revenue
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT i.institution_id,
       i.institution_name,
       ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY debt_to_asset_ratio DESC, i.institution_id;

SELECT 
    c.institution_id,
    ROUND(c.tier1_capital * 1.0 / c.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_capital_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot c
WHERE c.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY core_tier1_capital_ratio DESC, c.institution_id;

SELECT i.institution_name AS institution_name,
       ROUND(fs.net_assets * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS net_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY net_capital_ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(fs.annual_revenue, 2) AS 营业收入,
       ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 100.0 / total_rev.total_revenue, 2) AS 占比
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
JOIN (SELECT SUM(fs2.annual_revenue) AS total_revenue
      FROM financial_snapshot fs2
      JOIN institution i2 ON i2.institution_id = REPLACE(fs2.party_id, 'PTY-', '')
      WHERE i2.institution_type = 'BANK') total_rev
WHERE i.institution_type = 'BANK'
  AND fs.annual_revenue * 100.0 / total_rev.total_revenue > 15
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.internal_rating <> ma.external_rating
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY cnt DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT 
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC, ma.valuation_method;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count,
       ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY cnt DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT so.authority_level,
       COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = 'FIXED'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') BETWEEN 0 AND 30
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_id,
       i.institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS under_provision_total,
       ROUND(fs.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets,
       ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) * 100.0 / fs.net_assets, 2) AS under_provision_pct
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN provision_snapshot p ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets
HAVING SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY under_provision_pct DESC, i.institution_id;

SELECT cg.grade_name_zh,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.exception_flag = 1
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY cnt DESC, cg.grade_name_zh;

SELECT 
    ou.institution_id AS 机构编号,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 不良借据笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = ld.loan_account_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || ou.institution_id
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
GROUP BY ou.institution_id
HAVING SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(fs.annual_revenue), 0) > 0.5
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
       ROUND(SUM(cs.risk_weighted_assets), 2) AS 风险加权资产,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 100.0 / SUM(cs.risk_weighted_assets), 2) AS 贷款占风险加权资产百分比
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
LEFT JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.status != 'CLOSED'
   OR ld.status IS NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(cs.risk_weighted_assets) > 0
ORDER BY 贷款占风险加权资产百分比 DESC, 机构名称 ASC;

SELECT pi.payment_mode,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY cnt DESC, pi.payment_mode;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS exception_count,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.exception_flag = 1 THEN p.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount,
       ROUND(fs.net_assets, 2) AS net_capital,
       ROUND(fs.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.exception_flag = 1 THEN p.amount_value ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / fs.net_assets, 4) AS pct_of_net_capital
FROM prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 p
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = p.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || p.institution_id
WHERE p.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets, fs.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
ORDER BY pct_of_net_capital DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.record_id) AS overdue_report_count,
       ROUND(AVG(l.principal_balance), 2) AS avg_ledger_balance,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.provision_gap > 0 THEN l.loan_id END) AS insufficient_provision_loan_count,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.provision_gap > 0 THEN p.provision_gap ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_provision_gap
FROM institution i
JOIN loan_drawdown l ON l.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT loan_id, (required_amount - recognized_amount) AS provision_gap
    FROM provision_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM provision_snapshot)
) p ON p.loan_id = l.loan_id
LEFT JOIN regulatory_submission_event_v3 r ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
    AND r.status_code = 'OVERDUE'
    AND (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
WHERE l.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.record_id) >= 25
ORDER BY total_provision_gap DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS facility_count,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN g.exception_flag = 1 THEN g.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS except_amount,
       ROUND(AVG(g.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN governance_control_record_v3 g ON g.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN g.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 5
ORDER BY except_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT p.display_name AS customer_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS related_target_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS relation_kind_cnt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_related_party_cnt
FROM related_transaction_record_v3 rtr
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = rtr.subject_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = rtr.subject_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE rtr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY related_target_cnt DESC, relation_kind_cnt DESC, customer_name ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS card_holder_count,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 1 THEN ore.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS operational_risk_exception_amount,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ore.record_id) AS operational_risk_record_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN account a ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN operational_risk_event_v3 ore ON ore.institution_id = i.institution_id AND ore.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ore.record_id) >= 43
ORDER BY operational_risk_exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS active_product_count,
       ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS total_actual_raise,
       COUNT(*) AS conduct_records,
       ROUND(AVG(r.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM product_conduct_event_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
LEFT JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id AND wp.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE r.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY total_actual_raise DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS 底层资产数,
       ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS 发行金额合计,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.record_id) AS 托管有效记录数,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.exception_flag = 1 THEN c.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 异常金额合计
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
LEFT JOIN custody_operation_event_v3 c ON c.subject_id = ma.asset_id AND c.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN c.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 发行金额合计 DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
